requirements: Locate each hand and finger crossing against the actual visible rifle surface before choosing a fit
Preserve licensed meshes, UVs, material, skin weights, bone parent chains, local positions and scales

Keep the accepted rifle pose, right palm and right index targets. Recalibrate the left palm from visible rigid source vertices, with at most 4 cm translation, unchanged wrist orientation, and a real supporting rifle face
Use a finite anatomically constrained fit with explicit evaluation limits, preserve failed candidates and avoid repeating rejected right-hand solvers
Zero crossing alone does not approve a grip: fingers must visibly wrap and contact the weapon without excessive joint bend
A changed grip requires new death/drop verification before any runtime integration

offline_search_limits.domain_note: Finite source-pose search bounds; not an anatomical range certification

remaining_gates: Natural left index, middle, ring and pinky wrapping with distributed palmar contact
Reviewed source-specific thumb palmar patch and inter-finger inspection
Conservative containment and coplanarity checks beyond transverse surface crossings
New death/drop verification for changed grip before runtime integration
